name: useWifiRTT
summary: Fine Timing Measurement (FTM / 802.11mc) distance to Wi-Fi access points.
plain: Measures round-trip time (RTT) distance between the phone and nearby Wi-Fi access points that support it, to place the phone indoors within about 1 to 2 meters without GPS.
description: startRanging(bssids) runs one real android.net.wifi.rtt.WifiRttManager.startRanging round and waits for the platform's callback. Each BSSID must match an 802.11mc responder in the latest Wi-Fi scan results (WifiManager.getScanResults); BSSIDs that cannot be ranged are never invented into results and are listed in unresolvedBssids with a reason (invalid_bssid, not_in_scan_results, not_80211mc_responder, exceeds_max_peers_N, permission_denied, rtt_unavailable, ranging_timeout, ranging_failed, no_result_returned). Each entry of rangingResults is one access point's RangingResult: status 0 is a measurement, and only then are distanceMm, distanceStdDevMm, rssi and the measurement counters set (they are null for status 1 fail and 2 responder without 802.11mc). When the whole request fails, rangingResults is empty and error carries the onRangingFailure code. Needs ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, plus NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES on Android 13+, declared and granted by the app; without them error starts with permission_denied.

returns.name: isSupported
returns.desc: Whether the device hardware features the Wi-Fi RTT ranging subsystem.

returns.name: isAvailable
returns.desc: Whether the Wi-Fi RTT ranging service is currently available (Wi-Fi and location on).

returns.name: isRanging
returns.desc: Whether a ranging round is in progress.

returns.name: rangingResults
returns.desc: Per-AP results of the last round: `bssid`, `status`, `statusName`, `distanceMm`, `distanceStdDevMm`, `rssi`, `numAttemptedMeasurements`, `numSuccessfulMeasurements`, `timestampMs`. Distance, deviation, RSSI and counters are null unless `status` is 0.

returns.name: unresolvedBssids
returns.desc: BSSIDs of the last request that produced no measurement, each as `{ bssid, reason }`.

returns.name: error
returns.desc: Why probing or the last ranging round failed (missing permission, RTT unavailable, timeout, onRangingFailure code), or null.

returns.name: startRanging
returns.desc: Runs one RTT ranging round against the given AP BSSIDs and resolves the platform's per-AP results (empty on failure, with the reason in error).

returns.name: refresh
returns.desc: Re-checks the availability status of the Wi-Fi RTT service.

actions.name: startRanging(bssids)
actions.desc: Performs one round-trip time ranging round to the target BSSIDs.
actions.output: Resolves the per-AP results. BSSIDs that were not ranged are in unresolvedBssids with the reason; an empty array with error set means the whole request failed.

agentNote: Requires Android 9+ (API 28) and ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION (plus NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES on Android 13+) granted by the app. Pass BSSIDs taken from a Wi-Fi scan; only access points that are 802.11mc responders can be ranged. Do not assume a distance for a BSSID missing from rangingResults: it is in unresolvedBssids with the reason.
